fullDescription: A sophisticated cybersecurity monitoring dashboard style featuring a deep-space dark mode, high-density data visualization, and a modern glassmorphic aesthetic. Optimized for SaaS, fintech, and security monitoring platforms, this design utilizes a bento-grid layout with vibrant blue and neon accents. It prioritizes information hierarchy through the use of editorial typography (Plus Jakarta Sans) and technical monospace (JetBrains Mono) for data integrity. Key features include scroll-triggered bar animations, pulsing status indicators, and subtle backdrop-blur glass surfaces.

structured.summary: A professional, data-dense cybersecurity dashboard design system named 'Aegis Dark'. It features a semi-transparent glassmorphic UI set against a near-black background, using vibrant blue gradients and neon status accents to highlight critical security metrics and attack vectors.

style.description: The style is 'Techno-Glassmorphism'. It uses a foundation of deep blacks (#050505) and dark grays (#0c0c0c) layered with semi-transparent panels. Typography pairs the high-readability 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for labels and UI elements with 'JetBrains Mono' for technical data like IP addresses and counts. The primary accent is a blue gradient (#3b82f6 to #60a5fa), with secondary semantic colors: Red (#ef4444) for alerts, Purple (#a855f7) for limits, and Green (#22c55e) for success. Micro-interactions include pulsing status dots and smooth CSS transitions on data bars.
style.prompt: Create a pixel-perfect dark mode dashboard UI with the following specs: Background: #050505. Surface: rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.7) with 12px backdrop-blur and 1px border rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08). Typography: Main font 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Data font 'JetBrains Mono'. Header labels: 10px-11px, font-weight 800, uppercase, tracking 0.2em, color #9ca3af. Primary metrics: 24px-36px, font-weight 900, white. Data Rows: Alternating background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.015), hover state rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04). Accents: Blue gradient linear-gradient(90deg, #3b82f6, #60a5fa). Shadows: Box-shadow 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3). Animations: Pulse effect on status indicators, 1000ms ease-out on bar widths.

layout_and_structure.description: A 12-column grid layout consisting of modular 'bento' cards of varying sizes (span-3 and span-6). The structure is divided into a utility header and two main rows of analytical widgets.

prompts.prompt: Horizontal bar with 100% width. Left side: Title 'Dashboard' in 24px bold. Right side: A control group containing a period selector (7d), a date range picker with 'lucide:calendar' icon, and an update frequency selector. Styling: Dark gray backgrounds #111, subtle 1px white/5 borders, text-xs size for labels.

Small cards (span-3). Top: Pulse indicator next to a tiny uppercase label. Center: Large numeric value (e.g., '245'). Bottom: Grid of 2x2 sub-metrics with 10px bold uppercase labels and white base values. Include a thin 2px high progress bar for primary health status.

Large central card (span-6). Header: 'LIVE' status with pulsing blue dot. Body: 3-column grid of summary metrics in tinted boxes (blue/white/purple at 5% opacity). Footer: A large license usage bar (100% width, 4px height) above an empty radial-gradient chart area for future data visualization.

Data-dense ranked list. Header: Icon, Title, and a refresh icon that rotates 360deg on hover. Content: Vertical list of rows. Each row: 110px width monospace IP address, 100% flexible width bar container, and a 30px right-aligned numeric count. Bars use a horizontal blue gradient. Rows alternate opacity for better readability.

Square card (span-3). Center: Large SVG-based circular progress bar (12px stroke) using #a855f7. Inside the circle: Percentage text in 30px black-weight font and a 'status' label in 8px uppercase tracking-tighter.

special_ui_components.description: A horizontal bar chart row designed for ranking data in small spaces.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: Flexbox layout with 16px gap. IP Column: JetBrains Mono, 11px, color #e5e7eb, fixed 110px. Bar Container: Height 10px, background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), full rounded corners. Filled Bar: linear-gradient(90deg, #3b82f6, #60a5fa), transition width 1s ease-out. Count Column: 11px font-bold, right-aligned, color white.

special_ui_components.description: An animated indicator for real-time monitoring status.
special_ui_components.prompt: 8px by 8px circle. Background: #ef4444 (red) or #22c55e (green). Animation: 'pulse' 2s infinite. keyframes pulse { 0% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1.2); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }. Box-shadow: 0 0 8px currentColor.
